logline: Makeover-show ensemble: Pochettino and his MU work crew try to rebuild the 18th-placed house; De Ligt's plank, Yoro's trip on Isak and two smashed windows wreck it in 13 minutes, Liverpool's crew finish it with a wrecking ball and take a selfie.

beats.idea: crumbling MAN UTD house, the door is a leaking goal (30 conceded), Carrick leaves with a box
Pochettino flips an hourglass: 'You will see, give me time' — the whole crew flips mini hourglasses
teamwork: Fernandes points, De Ligt spins a plank — bonk, bonk — scaffolding, roof and wall go

8'-13': De Ligt drops the plank, Yoro dives on Isak, ref's red, Pochettino and Fernandes protest; MU crew makes a wall, Szoboszlai's free kick and Wirtz's backheel smash the windows; Liverpool fans laugh
Ngumoha and Muñoz drive the wrecking-ball crane: 66', 82'; MU crew scatters; shots 28-10
Pochettino: red card unfair; GIVE ME TIME sign; a brick smashes the hourglass
pull back: Liverpool crew group selfie in front of the rubble; 'the size of the mess'; next: Sporting

twist: the rebuild's first job is a demolition: Anfield 4-0
callback: the hourglass flipped at 'give me time' is smashed at the end
hidden_details: the 18th sign hangs from one nail
meme_frame: Pochettino holding GIVE ME TIME as the wrecking ball hits
